scripts.build: npm run markdown-to-html; npm run add-markdown-css
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "chokidar README.md template.html footer.html -c 'npm run build'" "live-server dist --no-browser"
scripts.markdown-to-html: cat template.html > dist/index.html && marked < README.md >> dist/index.html && cat footer.html >> dist/index.html
scripts.deploy: git add dist && git commit -m 'deploy' && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages
